source_title: Wife Laura defends Russell Brand; backs his character in rape case
source_excerpt: Trigger warning: This article contains mentions of rape and abuseRussell Brand's wife, Laura Brand attended his rape and sexual assault case recently at the Southwark Crown Court in London. During the hearing, the couple reportedly maintained a united front, and Laura even spoke up to defend her actor husband.Russell Brand's wife speaks in his defenceBBC reported that Brand and his wife attended the latest court hearing on Thursday. During the hearing, Laura was summoned, where she vouched for her husband's character and shared how well Russell managed the business, and shared "The way he treats me, he knows... I feel very seen by him... I love him very much."Giving evidence at Southwark Crown Court in London on Thursday, she was asked whether he had been respectful to her, to which she had replied yes, and had also commented on how the two had met for the first time in Edinburgh."I was invested; we both had told each other we loved each other, but it was clear it was difficult for him to be monogamous", she explained.The actor has been accused on three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one of attempted indecent assault. He denies all the charges and has pleaded not guilty. The charges against Brand come from allegations that were made by six female complainants spanning a 10-year period between 1999 and 2009.
